en: The Nikkei only closed +0.5% today, but ~90% of Prime stocks were actually up 🫢 oil fell on the Middle East de-escalation. meanwhile Shin-Etsu posted higher profit and still dropped 8% — guidance below expectations, ouch. #JapanStocks
